For each listed gas station, return the GasStationID, the aggregate premium revenue, and the month (in YYYYMM format) during which that station recorded its maximum monthly premium revenue.

WITH premium_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        t."GasStationID",
        t."CustomerID",
        strftime('%Y%m', t."Date") AS month,
        (t."Amount" * t."Price") AS revenue,
        c."Segment"
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN "customers" c ON t."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
    JOIN "products" p ON t."ProductID" = p."ProductID"
    WHERE p."Description" LIKE '%Super%' OR p."Description" LIKE '%Special%'
),
station_month_rev AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        GasStationID,
        month,
        SUM(revenue) AS month_rev
    FROM premium_transactions
    GROUP BY Segment, GasStationID, month
),
station_total_rev AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        GasStationID,
        SUM(month_rev) AS total_rev
    FROM station_month_rev
    GROUP BY Segment, GasStationID
),
station_max_month AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        GasStationID,
        month AS max_month,
        month_rev AS max_month_rev
    FROM (
        SELECT
            Segment,
            GasStationID,
            month,
            month_rev,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment, GasStationID ORDER BY month_rev DESC, month) AS rn
        FROM station_month_rev
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.Segment,
        s.GasStationID,
        s.total_rev,
        m.max_month,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.Segment ORDER BY s.total_rev DESC) AS rn
    FROM station_total_rev s
    JOIN station_max_month m
        ON s.Segment = m.Segment AND s.GasStationID = m.GasStationID
)
SELECT
    GasStationID,
    total_rev AS premium_revenue,
    max_month
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY Segment, total_rev DESC;

FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND p.Description = 'Nafta'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012';

SELECT SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND p.Description = 'Nafta' AND strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012'

SELECT SUM(t."Amount" * t."Price") AS total_spent
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "customers" c ON t."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
JOIN "products" p ON t."ProductID" = p."ProductID"
WHERE c."Segment" = 'LAM'
  AND p."Description" = 'Nafta'
  AND t."Date" BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31';
